propositions: A new read-only command `rebar bridge suggest-mapping <PROJECT>` probes a live Jira instance to discover real vocabulary (issue types, statuses, link types, priorities, hierarchy) and emit a suggested [tool.rebar.mapping] configuration block with identity-seed axis maps.

The probe uses only documented high-level pycontribs `jira.JIRA` public methods (issue_types, statuses, priorities, issue_link_types, createmeta APIs, search_issues, transitions) without private REST endpoints or getjson.

The --write flag deep-merges the discovered mapping into an existing rebar.toml or creates one, preserving existing hand-edited keys and flat [jira]/[tracker] sections; pyproject.toml is never modified.

Transition hints are collected from sample issues per discovered type and marked best-effort/partial since Jira returns transitions only from each sample's current status; the status_map remains identity-seeded.

Serialization splits flat and nested TOML: a new orchestrator _emit_config_toml handles flat top-level sections via the existing _emit_toml, then appends nested [mapping.*] tables via new _emit_nested_toml, preserving the fail-closed contract of _emit_toml.
The probe is fully offline-testable via a fake port; no live Jira, credentials, or CI gating is required for unit tests.
